notes: The sentence is about a lobby game, so Party & Casual leads, but the thing you actually do is design an avatar, which is real work only Roleplay & Avatar Sim can express — hence both genres named. The answers rule out a runway and any separate match area, so the gathering space is the play space: space-bounded in this genre's wording, not space-staged, which would have cost P4 for a stage nobody asked for. I took the secondary genre's Dress Up preset and substituted that shape for its stage-runway, keeping its social hub and mirror-style photo spots, and added trigger-scoring because the roughly eight doorways are detection volumes that apply the next outfit piece as players pass through. With no user to ask I sized it as one compact boutique hall as answered, kept everything inside that hall so there is no exterior transition and no P3, and treated the design loop as continuous with no finish to place.
